using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.LiveTv.IO.Tests
{
    public class EncodedRecorderTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<EncodedRecorder>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly EncodedRecorder _recorder;

        public EncodedRecorderTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<EncodedRecorder>>();
            // Create minimal mocks for other dependencies
            var mediaEncoderMock = new Mock<IMediaEncoder>();
            mediaEncoderMock.Setup(m => m.EncoderPath).Returns("/path/to/ffmpeg");
            var appPathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            appPathsMock.Setup(a => a.LogDirectoryPath).Returns("/logs");
            var serverConfigMock = new Mock<IServerConfigurationManager>();

            _recorder = new EncodedRecorder(
                _loggerMock.Object,
                mediaEncoderMock.Object,
                appPathsMock.Object,
                serverConfigMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Stop_WhenProcessWaitForExitCalled_LogsWaitForExitMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            _recorder.GetType().GetField("_hasExited", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(_recorder, false);
            var processMock = new Mock<Process>();
            processMock.Setup(p => p.WaitForExit(10000)).Returns(true);
            _recorder.GetType().GetField("_process", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(_recorder, processMock.Object);
            _recorder.GetType().GetField("_targetPath", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(_recorder, "/test/path.mkv");

            // Act
            _recorder.Stop();

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                logger => logger.LogInformation(
                    "Calling recording process.WaitForExit for {Path}",
                    "/test/path.mkv"),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
